title: Declare Intent comparison histories through MakeMe

intentCoverage.report:
Dough Intent Coverage: one scratch break check

Verdict: Caught (only on the proofless Baseline ancestor-walk path that was observed).

Story and revision: SEED-353#declare-intent-comparison-histories (.planning/seeds/SEED-353-declarative-git-test-state.md), plan 643 slice 3, revision 1d3b433bf7fdbd8e1858e0d62e623539f6d67b06 (claude/declare-intent-comparison-histories-through-make).
Promise checked: from the seed's Key examples, "Planning-only, code, cancelled and proofless cases retain their distinct exact, ancestor, equivalent, later-build and unavailable results". Narrowed to the proofless part: an endpoint walk passes a nearer build that has no usable proof, and selects the older usable ancestor as "ancestor".

Fault: dashboard/server/baseCiRevisionNearest.ts, nearestRevisionBuild, proof gate (line 196): `if (await proofUsable(build)) {` became `if ((await proofUsable(build)) || true) {`, so a proofless timed build counts as usable. The proof read still runs. No fixtures or assertions were edited. A shell trap restored the file with `git checkout`.
Why the caller's fault changed: the proof gate is shared by the Baseline, Branch and Trunk Landed walks and is the production rule the deleted proofless-parent E2E publisher exercised. The cancelled-landing forward walk lives in laterTrunkBuild.ts and does not reach this gate; all four ci-comparison-cancelled.spec.ts tests passed under the fault, so this probe gives no verdict on the cancelled path or on the planning-only/code classification.

Setup: detached scratch worktree of the selected revision, Node 24.21.0, `npm ci --ignore-scripts`, clean before the probe; the story worktree was never edited.
Command (all three runs): `env -u NO_COLOR -u FORCE_COLOR -u GIT_ALTERNATE_OBJECT_DIRECTORIES OPEN_DOUGH_DASHBOARD_BACKEND_PROOF_RECORD=<json> caffeinate -s -i npm run test:dashboard:backend -- intent/ci-comparison-selection.spec.ts intent/ci-comparison-cancelled.spec.ts --workers=1`.

Runs:
- Baseline: 9 selected, all passed, including "Baseline passes a nearer proofless build and names the older usable ancestor".
- Faulted: 9 selected; 1 failed at dashboard/backend-tests/intent/ci-comparison-selection.spec.ts:47 ("Baseline passes a nearer proofless build and names the older usable ancestor"), its `expect(await answer(evidence)).toMatchObject(...)` at line 83. Received baseline {revision bbbb… (the proofless start build), runId 2, selection "exact", laterWithoutResult 0}; expected {revision aaaa…, runId 1, selection "ancestor", laterWithoutResult 1}.
- Restored: file matched HEAD; 9 selected, all passed. Scratch worktree removed; story worktree clean.

Checks examined: ci-comparison-selection.spec.ts (5 tests), ci-comparison-cancelled.spec.ts (4 tests). Frontend mounted specs not run (fault caught in backend, not presentation-level).

Next proof action: none for the proofless Baseline gate. The cancelled later-build path or the planning-only versus code classification would need a separate probe.
Already-planned repair or prior disposition: none recognized.

Costs:
- Test runtime: measured from proof-record durationMs: baseline 2.01 s, faulted 2.56 s, restored 2.66 s (about 7.2 s); an earlier baseline without a proof record took 9.5 s wall-clock; load average about 14-17.
- Human effort: unavailable (no human interaction during the probe).
- Agent effort: unavailable (no token or tool-time meter; about 15 tool calls, not an effort measure).
- Invocation-to-report elapsed: 106987 ms (measured), from 1795023113000 to 1795023219987 Unix epoch ms.

Wrap-up disposition: checked revision 1d3b433bf7fdbd8e1858e0d62e623539f6d67b06; verdict Caught; no follow-up.
